contribution_types.description:
Introduction to Ivan Leku 

here is the profile of Ivan Leku, a reliable hard working friend i know from my time in Uganda - https://www.linkedin.com/in/ivan-leku-6537446a/ - his uncle is the former ambassador of Uganda to China and his family is in fact the descendant from the royal family from Uganda (but no longer ruling the coutry)

Introduction to Jophes

Jophes, a student at the time but now quite active, also good to know https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhindo-jophes/

During my assignment with Yara in 2021 I dug a bit deeper in China's agricultural development and noticed a lot going on around ecosystems and value chains being built, and how blockchain was an enabler for this, the concept of GEP was particularly interesting

Gross Ecosystem Production, which allows to turn individual players that are hard to invest (eg. an AI company that improves cameras in drones to spot and address plant diseases) into an an easily investible ecosystem that includes the whole value chain from land to crop to farmer to harvesting to logistics to e-commerce to the cities and including finance and insurance - all in line with the goals of the central plan economy and therefore supported (the basket of eggs I mentioned above)
